name: Gale Organ
bio: Hush Concord siege rig, crewed by Flue or a skirmisher. Gains 1 Pressure at the end of each round; at Pressure 3 it discharges. While Pressure is 2+, sound within 30 ft is dampened. Track Pressure by hand.

actions.name: Discharge (Pressure 3)
actions.desc: 60-foot line, 10 feet wide. DC 13 Dexterity saving throw: 3d8 force damage (half on a success); a failed save is also pushed 15 feet and knocked prone. Pressure resets to 0. If destroyed at Pressure 2+, it vents in a 10-foot burst (DC 13 Dex, 2d8 force).
